
[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- main.volt:2[/yellow bold]

GPIO 1 is used by UART0 (USB serial). Using it will break serial monitor and firmware flashing.

 [dim]1 |[/dim] hardware {
 [dim]2 |[/dim]     pin x: Output = 1
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Use a different pin unless you specifically intend to disable serial output.[/cyan]
